about_short_description.short_description: Kroll Bond Rating Agency is a rating agency that offers transparent, timely credit ratings, and research ratings.

identifier.value: Credit Ratings

product.name: Credit Ratings
product.description: Independent credit ratings that assess the creditworthiness and default risk of issuers, debt instruments, and structured finance transactions.

identifier.value: Structured Finance Ratings

product.name: Structured Finance Ratings
product.description: Ratings and analysis for securitized debt transactions, including asset-backed securities, residential and commercial mortgage-backed securities, and collateralized loan obligations.

identifier.value: Financial Institutions and Insurance Ratings

product.name: Financial Institutions and Insurance Ratings
product.description: Credit ratings for banks, specialty finance companies, broker-dealers, asset managers, and insurance companies and their debt obligations.

identifier.value: Corporate and Project Finance Ratings

product.name: Corporate and Project Finance Ratings
product.description: Ratings for corporate issuers, corporate debt, leveraged finance, infrastructure, and project finance obligations.

identifier.value: Public Finance and Sovereign Ratings

product.name: Public Finance and Sovereign Ratings
product.description: Credit ratings for state and local governments, public-sector entities, transportation and infrastructure obligations, and sovereign or supranational issuers.

identifier.value: Credit Research and Ratings Surveillance

product.name: Credit Research and Ratings Surveillance
product.description: Credit research, market commentary, and ongoing surveillance that explain rating methodologies, sector conditions, and changes in credit quality.
